name: function-reconstruction-from-boundary-data
description: Reconstruct an unknown function from observations of its inputs, outputs, and boundary conditions using constrained least-squares fitting with selected basis functions.

config.instruction: Pair input-output measurements with uncertainty bounds. Classify as boundary or interior. Translate physical constraints into mathematical form.
Select basis functions based on observed smoothness and constraint compatibility. Define regularization strategy.
Minimize weighted squared residuals subject to constraints. Compute coefficient covariance and pointwise confidence band.
Evaluate the fitted function beyond the observed range. Identify where extrapolation violates constraints and compute the divergence rate.
